mentions.name: Magic Draft
mentions.description: A feature in Ditto that helps designers and writers create the "draft and a half" directly in Figma, using a hierarchy of all available context (text, Ditto metadata, the design, style guides) to write strong starting-point copy.
mentions.source_excerpt: Professionally, working on “Magic Draft,” a feature in Ditto to help designers and writers create the “draft and a half” directly in Figma, which uses a hierarchy of all your context (text, Ditto metadata, the design, your style guides, etc) to write really good starting point copy.
